intro: Set up the timer in short sections. Start with timing and lifecycle, then open only the event bonuses, controls, or visual options you want to customize.

sections.title: 1. Quick start
sections.description: Turn the timer on, choose which live platforms can affect it, and set the starting time.

sections.title: 2. Stream lifecycle
sections.description: Decide how the timer behaves when your stream starts or ends.

sections.title: 3. Manual controls
sections.description: Choose how Streamer.bot actions and moderator commands can control the timer.

sections.title: 4. Core event bonuses
sections.description: Set the time awards for follows, subscriptions, memberships, gifted subs, and raids.

sections.title: 5. Gift and like bonuses
sections.description: Set the cross-platform gift bonus and the thresholded TikTok-like bonus so the timer does not jump on every single like.

sections.title: 6. Bits and Power-Ups
sections.description: Accumulate Twitch Bits and Power-Up Bits without repeating awards for the same completed threshold.

sections.title: 7. Donations and purchases
sections.description: Optional Streamlabs and Ko-fi awards. Currency conversion is never inferred, and verified provider IDs are required by default.

sections.title: 8. Twitch milestones
sections.description: Optionally reward unique Hype Train levels, Watch Streaks, and Modiversary months.

sections.title: 9. Overlay layout
sections.description: Choose the timer label, font, background behavior, progress bar, and warning thresholds.

sections.title: 10. Overlay colors
sections.description: Customize the timer background, accent, text, state, and border colors.

sections.title: 11. Review before enabling
sections.description: Review the privacy and safety defaults before enabling production event awards.
sections.notice: No external API is used. The add-on stores only bounded timer counters, session timestamps, current live-platform state, and threshold progress. It does not store chat text, viewer identities, donation messages, or purchase item data. New financial and Twitch milestone awards default to 0 until you enable them. Import the separate Subathon Timer Streamer.bot package for optional Start, Pause, Resume, Reset, and Add Time controls.
